IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'silver')
BEGIN
    EXEC ('CREATE SCHEMA silver');
END;
GO

CREATE TABLE silver.crypto_candles
(
    trading_pair                VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    base_asset                  VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL,
    quote_asset                 VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL,

    open_timestamp              DATETIME2     NOT NULL,
    close_timestamp             DATETIME2     NOT NULL,
    trade_date                  DATE          NOT NULL,

    open_price                  FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    high_price                  FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    low_price                   FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    close_price                 FLOAT         NOT NULL,

    volume                      FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    quote_volume                FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    number_of_trades             INT           NOT NULL,
    taker_buy_base_volume       FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    taker_buy_quote_volume      FLOAT         NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(trading_pair),
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);  

CREATE TABLE silver.crypto_candles2
(
    trading_pair                VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,

    open_price                  FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    high_price                  FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    low_price                   FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    close_price                 FLOAT         NOT NULL,

    volume                      FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    quote_volume                FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    number_of_trades             INT           NOT NULL,
    taker_buy_base_volume       FLOAT         NOT NULL,
    taker_buy_quote_volume      FLOAT         NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(trading_pair),
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);  

select * from sys.tables;

SELECT * FROM silver.crypto_candles 
WHERE trading_pair = 'BTCUSDT' 
ORDER BY open_timestamp DESC;

SELECT COUNT(open_timestamp) FROM silver.crypto_candles;

SELECT DISTINCT trading_pair FROM silver.crypto_candles;

TRUNCATE TABLE silver.crypto_candles2;
select * from silver.crypto_candles2;

delete from silver.crypto_candles where trading_pair = 'BTCUSDT';

DELETE FROM logging.TrackingTable where trading_pair IN ('BTCUSDT', 'ETHUSDT') AND Table_Name = 'crypto_candles';
